title: TS-55 Host and starter observability: structured log lines
description: From the TS-53 live rehearsal: the ECS log group had exactly one line (computer_host_worker_start) and the Lambdas logged nothing of the app flow, so claim, regate, result, heartbeat, snapshot hydrate and publish, boot readiness and exit cannot be verified from CloudWatch. Add structured JSON log lines (event, tenant_id, computer_id, action_id, kind, durations, outcome; never secrets, tokens, command output or file contents) at: host boot start/ready/exit with reason, register, each claim/regate/result with outcome, each heartbeat failure, snapshot hydrate/publish start/end; domain/computer-start.ts start dispatch and lease decisions; FrontDoor host routes accept/refuse. Tests assert the lines and that secrets never appear; mutation-check.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Add from TS-56: structured success lines for snapshot hydrate and publish (generation, bytes) in computer/host/src/boot.ts and disk-lifecycle.ts; document that host_start_generation is bumped by the starter before the host boots (it was 3 while stopped=true); consider exposing the live-writer lock on GET computer for operators.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Add from the TS-58/59 live proof: expose hostLostAt and hostLostGeneration on GET /orgs/{t}/computer (they are stored but not in the API view); hosts take 25-60 s from start to workspace_ready and linger about 2 minutes after the last turn before self-exit (consider an idle timeout shorter than the 120 s worker window).

right_now_summary: The team is adding structured logs and exposing host timing data to verify computer startup and activity.
